text:
noah: Quick bench launch plan: need a single-hook, three visual panels, short webinar script, and form routing. Keep it squarely for engineers.

tess: Hook ideas: 
- "Cut inference spend. Keep SLOs."
- "Predictable costs. Dependable latency.
My pick: first one but shortened: 'Cut spend. Keep SLOs.'

omar: Charts we can ship: 1) cost waterfall per 1M tokens (show batching + cache gains), 2) latency percentiles by seq length heatmap, 3) scatter dollars-per-1k-reqs vs requests/sec. Short captions only.

lia: Webinar: 25 minutes total. 7m why unit economics matter, 12m walkthrough of charts with live estimator demo, 6m Q&A. CTA = 'Run your estimate'.

design-bot: Visuals: three-up hero tiles with consistent numeric callouts, palette = teal/amber, annotate knees and callouts. Provide alt text for each image.

noah: Form schema: fields = ['avg_seq_length','peak_reqs_s','deployment_choice']; hidden utm_campaign=microbench_launch_2026; tag submissions 'bench_interest'. Routing: if peak_reqs_s bucket >=200k OR deployment_choice=private -> sdr-sla; else growth-nurture.

tess: Copy for 150-word blog intro ready, will post for edit. Social micro: 'How much does inference really cost? Run a quick estimate.'

omar: I'll export CSV slices and PNGs by EOD. Can expose a small estimator API to prefill from form.

lia: A/B test CTA: A='Run your estimate', B='Estimate costs'. Track calc_submitted.

noah: Timeline: assets by EOD, draft social + blog by 3pm, routing setup before tomorrow morning. Meeting: review 2026-03-26 09:00 PT.

design-bot: Meeting scheduled: 'Microbench creative review' 2026-03-26 09:00 PT.

noah: Sweet. Keep public copy numeric and tradeoff-focused; keep implementation details in appendix. :thumbsup:
